svg.title: Mayank Verma — About
svg.desc: Analyst by craft. Creator by instinct. I work with data, build useful things with AI, and share what I learn along the way. From dashboards and automation to content and products, I enjoy making complex ideas simple enough to use. Portrait of Mayank Verma.
